description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for search filter parameters related to I18N import errors, specifically for filtering based on language ID and employee number in the OrangeHRM application.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for encapsulating search filter parameters such as language ID and employee number, extending from the base FilterParams class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'importError.langString'.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Returns the language ID set in the filter parameters.

methods.name: setLanguageId
methods.description: Sets the language ID for the filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number set in the filter parameters.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter parameters.
